tree_dirty_detail: This rehearsal (W24b) was commissioned as 'over committed bytes at HEAD 86a5007, clean tree', but git status --short was not actually empty when the rehearsal ran: docs/validation/M8/05-budgets.json, docs/validation/M8/05-measurement.json and docs/validation/M8/05.md carry uncommitted M8-05 perf-budget recalibration edits (dated 2026-09-15, unrelated to this task), plus an untracked docs/validation/M8/clients/attempt-14/ directory. Confirmed archive_size_core_bytes stayed unchanged at 12700000 in the dirty 05-budgets.json (only latency/RSS/binary-size magnitudes were recalibrated), so the budget comparison below is unaffected. All packaging/build inputs (Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, src/, scripts/release-artifact.py, scripts/release-smoke.py, scripts/contract-freeze.py, docs/validation/M8/freeze-0.8.0.json) were unmodified and matched HEAD exactly; only the two unrelated docs files above and the untracked client-matrix directory were dirty.

scope.note: No tag was created and nothing was pushed or published; --tag v0.8.0 is a local packaging argument matching Cargo.toml's committed version.

steps.description: Confirm the workspace version matches the tag under rehearsal.
Rebuild the release binary locked and offline against the current working tree (already up to date at HEAD 86a5007; no recompilation needed).
Verify the current tool snapshots against the committed 0.8.0 freeze manifest before packaging.
Build the deterministic core archive, inventory, SPDX SBOM and third-party notices from the built binary.
Compare the generated archive size against the archive_size_core_bytes budget (12.7 MB; confirmed unchanged in the dirty 05-budgets.json).
Copy the archive and SHA256SUMS into a fresh clean directory under target/, simulating a clean download separate from the build output directory.

release-smoke.py from the clean-download directory: extracts, verifies SHA-256 against SHA256SUMS, installs into an ephemeral 0700 directory, runs --version/version --json/doctor --json, then serve --stdio with tools/list (36, exact hash match against the committed contract) and four representative tools/call requests, tears down and confirms no leaked process group. Passed on the first attempt: the two TOOL_SCHEMA_SHA256 pins fixed during W24 (rust.binary.bloat, rust.analyzer.action.apply) are already correct on the committed tree.
Regression guard: full release-smoke.py unit test suite.

Extracted the clean-download archive to a manual install directory and ran version --json, doctor --json and contract --json directly against the archived binary (independent of release-smoke.py's own install/verify path); confirmed by field-level comparison that description_sha256/input_schema_sha256/output_schema_sha256/stability/annotations match docs/validation/M8/freeze-0.8.0.json exactly for all 36 tools (the freeze manifest also carries snapshot_sha256 and the live contract carries executes_project_code/requires_runtime, which are additive fields outside the compared set, not mismatches).
steps.excerpt: version.version=0.8.0; doctor.mode=passive,status=warning; contract.tool_count=36, per-tool description/input/output schema hashes and annotations match freeze-0.8.0.json for all 36 tools, 0 mismatches

steps.description: Manual MCP stdio session against the extracted binary: initialize, tools/list, resources/templates/list.
steps.excerpt: tools/list: 36 tools; resources/templates/list: 2 templates — rust-artifact://{project_ref}/{artifact_id} and rust-quality-artifact://{project_ref}/{quality_job_id_or_artifact_id}{?offset,length} (RFC 6570 form, confirmed — this corrects the stale ?offset={n}&length={n} form cited in prior evidence per V03b P2-3)

steps.description: Cleanup: removed the local rehearsal scratch directory under target/ (clean-download copies, manual install, dist output).

notes: The tree was not clean when this rehearsal ran (see tree_dirty_detail), unlike the premise this task was commissioned under. All packaging/build inputs matched HEAD 86a5007 exactly; the two dirty docs files (05-budgets.json, 05-measurement.json, 05.md) hold an unrelated M8-05 perf-budget recalibration that left archive_size_core_bytes unchanged, and the untracked docs/validation/M8/clients/attempt-14/ directory is unrelated client-matrix evidence. Neither was read from, written to, or otherwise used by this rehearsal.
V03b P2-3 (stale resources/templates/list evidence citing the pre-RFC-6570 ?offset={n}&length={n} form) is resolved by step 10: the live server returns the RFC 6570 form {?offset,length}.
